title: Concrete Pouring Permit
name: Concrete Pouring Permit
description: Pre-pour hold-point and work authorisation for concrete placement, covering formwork / falsework, reinforcement and embeds, plant access, wet-cement exposure, quality checks and safe hand-back.

fields.label: Construction Drawing / Pour Card Reference and Revision

sections.title: DRAWINGS, REINFORCEMENT AND EMBEDDED ITEMS
items: The latest approved drawings and specifications are available at the pour location
Reinforcement size, spacing, laps, couplers and cover have been checked against the design
Cast-in items, bolts, sleeves, waterstops, services and openings have been checked
Construction joints, stop ends and interfaces with previous concrete are prepared as specified
The pour area is clean and free from unacceptable debris, standing water or contamination
Survey / dimensional checks and required hold points have been completed

fields.label: Design / Quality Hold Point Released By

sections.title: FORMWORK, FALSEWORK AND TEMPORARY WORKS
items: Formwork / falsework is installed in accordance with its design or approved standard arrangement
Supports, props, ties, bracing, foundations and bearing surfaces have been inspected
The temporary works are capable of carrying the foreseeable wet-concrete and construction loads
Access platforms, edges and openings are protected for the pour operation
Any temporary works inspection / permit-to-load hold point has been completed before pouring
Unauthorised alteration or removal of formwork / supports during the pour is prevented

fields.label: Formwork / Falsework Design or Standard Arrangement Reference
Temporary Works Permit-to-Load / Pour Release Reference (if applicable)
Formwork / Temporary Works Inspection Completed By

sections.title: DELIVERY, PUMPING, PLANT AND TRAFFIC CONTROL
items: Concrete delivery and pump / placing plant positions are planned before the pour starts
Vehicle and pedestrian routes are segregated and reversing is minimised
Pump outriggers / stabilisers are positioned on suitable ground or designed support
Concrete pump lines, couplings, restraints and end hoses are suitable and checked before use
Exclusion zones are provided around moving plant, suspended skips and line-of-fire hazards
Overhead services and other clearance restrictions have been assessed

fields.label: Pump Setup / Outrigger / Ground Support Details

sections.title: WET CEMENT, COSHH, PPE AND WELFARE
items: Wet-cement skin and eye exposure has been assessed under the site COSHH arrangements
Workers have suitable waterproof gloves and protective clothing for the task
Footwear and clothing arrangements prevent wet concrete being trapped against the skin
Eye / face protection is available where splashing is foreseeable
Clean water and suitable washing / welfare facilities are immediately available
Workers understand the need to remove contaminated clothing and wash exposed skin promptly

sections.title: POUR SEQUENCE, QUALITY AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROLS
items: The pour sequence and placement rate are compatible with the formwork / temporary works design
Concrete delivery tickets and specification will be checked before discharge
Specified testing, sampling and quality records are arranged
Vibration / compaction equipment is suitable and available
Weather conditions and the planned concrete protection / curing measures have been assessed
Concrete washout and waste arrangements prevent uncontrolled discharge

fields.label: Pour Sequence / Placement Rate / Lift Details
Required Slump / Flow / Cube / Other Test Regime
Weather Conditions / Hot, Cold, Wind or Rain Controls
Concrete Washout / Waste Location and Controls

sections.title: AUTHORISATION TO POUR
items: All required pre-pour inspections and hold points are complete
The pour team has been briefed on the sequence, hazards and stop-work conditions
Linked permits and temporary works controls remain valid for the planned pour
The person authorising the pour is satisfied that concrete placement can start

sections.title: COMPLETION, CURING AND HAND-BACK
items: The pour is complete and the final concrete level / finish has been checked
Formwork / falsework remains in place for the required period and will only be altered under the approved sequence
Curing and protection measures have been installed
Test samples, delivery records and pour records have been completed
Spills, washout and access routes have been left safe and controlled
Any defects, delays, cold joints or deviations have been recorded and escalated
